newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares inch up, Hermis Bank in demand.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares inch up, Hermis Bank in demand.

text.p: *Hermis Bank shares see 1.7 million litas in block trades.
Lithuanian shares gained for the second straight day on Monday amid a mood of cautious optimism and heavy block trading in Hermis Bank shares.
"Basically, we are feeling that the market is starting to move up," said Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema. "We are actually optimistic."
The official index rose 10.25 points to 920 points and group A shares advanced 5.49 points to 2,024.92 points. Central market turnover was 870,000 litas.
Hermis Bank shares were the most active in block trading, turning over 1.7 million litas with a price range of 50.00 litas to 169.00 litas.
Hermis Bank shares were up on the central market, rising to 180.00 litas from 174.00 litas in turnover of 90,000 litas.
Brokers have high hopes that Hermis Bank shares will live up to the positive results the bank announced for the first four months of the year.
"It would be quite normal to expect a rise in Hermis Bank shares in the future," said Grazina Bachiuliene, a broker with Vilfima.
"Vilniaus Bank is at a higher price than Hermis Bank and it's difficult to understand the price difference," Bachiuliene said.
Vilniaus Bank shares were unchanged today at 232.00 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese shares were among other gainers, rising to 43.00 litas from 42.50 litas.
"It's quite a profitable company and is working well," said one dealer.
